t: This is the Queen Victoria Memorial Cattle Trough in Finsbury Square. It commemorates Queen Victoria, who reigned for sixty-three years, longer than any monarch before her, and gave her name to the Victorian era. It was a time of great industrial, political, scientific and military change, and the British Empire expanded enormously. In 1876 Parliament gave her the additional title of Empress of India. A drinking trough is a modest sort of memorial, but it honours a very large reign.
